kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انفقأت (form VII)
# اِنْفَقَأْتُ (infaqaʔtu) /in.fa.qaʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْفَقَأَ (infaqaʔa)
# اِنْفَقَأْتَ (infaqaʔta) /in.fa.qaʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْفَقَأَ (infaqaʔa)
# اِنْفَقَأْتِ (infaqaʔti) /in.fa.qaʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْفَقَأَ (infaqaʔa)
# اِنْفَقَأَتْ (infaqaʔat) /in.fa.qa.ʔat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
